ddl.name: groupConversation_creation_intent_check
ddl.value:
(`group_conversation`.`creation_idempotency_key` IS NULL AND `group_conversation`.`creation_payload_hash` IS NULL)
        OR (`group_conversation`.`creation_idempotency_key` IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(`group_conversation`.`creation_idempotency_key`)) > 0
          AND `group_conversation`.`creation_payload_hash` IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: event_response_reason_only_with_no_check
ddl.value: `event_response`.`answer` = 'No' OR (`event_response`.`absence_reason_id` IS NULL AND `event_response`.`reason_text` IS NULL)

ddl.name: event_target_not_empty_check
ddl.value: `event_target`.`group_id` IS NOT NULL OR `event_target`.`voice_family` IS NOT NULL
